title: ReviewSyncResult
description:
Answer of `POST /v1/reviews/sync`: one poll per context and forge host that has a
credential, sorted by context, then host.

ContextName.description: Context name: 1 to 64 lowercase ASCII letters, digits and `-`. The first character is a letter. The last character is not `-`.

ForgeKind.description: Forge that hosts a remote (`[forges."<host>"] kind`).

ReviewList.description: A list of a poll that can fail without stopping the poll.

ReviewListFailure.description: A list that failed while the poll went on.

error.description: Why, for humans. Never contains the token.

oneOf.description:
The forge refuses this list to the token: a permission is missing, and a retry does not
help.

ReviewSync.description: The poll of one forge host for one context.

last_success.description: The time of the last poll that succeeded, by this loomd.

error.description: Why, for humans. Never contains the token.

key.description: The key of the MR, such as `acme/shop#412`.

ReviewSyncOutcome.description: What a poll of a forge host did.

oneOf.description: The host answered. An MR that failed is in `failed`: the others are synced.

added.description: The keys of the MRs that this poll added to the queue.

changed.description: The Review tasks whose status or mirror changed.

failed.description: The MRs whose sync failed: what the poll did not read keeps its last snapshot.

failed_lists.description:
The lists that failed while the poll went on. The reason `mentioned` keeps its last
value. Each MR that the poll read follows that read for the other reasons.

mrs.description:
The MRs polled, each one once: the MRs to review, the MRs of the queue and the MRs of
the Review tasks.

other_context.description: The MRs to review that belong to another context: not written to this store.

removed.description: The keys of the MRs that this poll removed from the queue.

oneOf.description:
The host limits the rate of requests until `until`. The poll did not run, or it stopped:
the MRs that it read before the limit are applied.

failed_lists.description: The lists that failed before the limit.

until.description: When the next poll can run.

oneOf.description: The poll stopped: each MR that it did not read keeps its last snapshot.

error.description: Why, for humans. Never contains the token.

failed_lists.description: The lists that failed before the stop.

TaskId.description: Task ID: 8 lowercase Crockford base32 characters, such as k3q7zm2a.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC with whole seconds, such as 2026-10-12T08:00:00Z.
